groups.title: The Go Type System
groups.question: Explain how Go copies values when you pass them around, and what that means for structs and slices.

followUps.Value vs Pointer Semantics: A function changes a struct field, but the caller doesn't see the change. Why, and how do you fix it?
followUps.Slices vs Arrays: What is inside a slice header, and why can append leave the original slice unchanged?

groups.title: Control Flow Idioms
groups.question: Explain how Go handles errors and cleanup, and how that differs from exceptions.

followUps.defer, panic & recover: When does a deferred call run, and why shouldn't panic and recover be your normal error handling?
followUps.Multiple Return Values & Error Handling: Why do Go functions return (value, error), and what goes wrong when you ignore the error with _?

groups.title: The Go CLI & Packages
groups.question: Explain how Go code is organized into packages, and the commands you use to build and run it.

followUps.Packages & the init Function: How does Go decide which names a package exports, and when does init run?
followUps.The go Command Toolchain: What do go build, go run and go test each do, and what does the -race flag add?

groups.title: Maps & Iteration
groups.question: Explain how maps and range loops behave in Go, including the cases that surprise people.

followUps.Map Internals & Nil Maps: Reading from a nil map works, but writing panics. Why, and how do you avoid it?
followUps.Range Loops & Loop Variable Capture: Why doesn't changing the loop variable in a range loop change the slice?
